cases.name: compute-aba-routing
cases.description: A mod-10 check digit, from a composed pack
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="packs" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="template" value="usa.finance.aba_routing"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-ordinal-suffix
cases.description: choose picks the right ordinal suffix, including the teens
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="packs" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="template" value="usa.geo.streetName"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-uuid-pack
cases.description: A pack that ships a rule rather than a list
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="packs" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="template" value="common.id.uuid"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-takes-no-draws
cases.description: A computed sequence draws nothing, so it shifts nothing after it
cases.config: <tdc><env count="4" seed="nodraw" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="100..999"/></sequence><sequence name="S"><compute><result><to_number><field name="A"/></to_number></result></compute></sequence><sequence name="B"><gen type="number" value="100..999"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A}},${{S}},${{B}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-reduce-and-encode
cases.description: reduce over a string, with encode folding letters to numbers
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Code"><gen type="text" value="AB12"/></sequence><sequence name="Sum"><compute><result><reduce><over><field name="Code"/></over><init><int v="0"/></init><do><add><acc/><to_number><encode as="base36"><current/></encode></to_number></add></do></reduce></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Code}}=${{Sum}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-euclidean-mod
cases.description: mod is always non-negative, whatever the host language does
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="M"><compute><result><concat><mod><int v="-7"/><int v="3"/></mod><str v=" "/><mod><int v="7"/><int v="-3"/></mod><str v=" "/><divide><int v="-7"/><int v="3"/></divide></concat></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{M}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-pad-and-slice
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><compute><let name="s"><str v="42"/></let><result><concat><pad width="6"><var name="s"/></pad><str v="|"/><pad width="6" fill="*"><var name="s"/></pad><str v="|"/><length><str v="hello"/></length></concat></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>
